newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bond prices close down on U.S. jobs data.
newsitem.headline: Danish bond prices close down on U.S. jobs data.

text.p: Danish bond prices closed lower on Friday after U.S. indicators showed a lower than expected rise in non-farm payrolls but unemployment at a 23-year low.

"It didn't make the market any the wiser, but we fell back marginally," a dealer said. He saw prices remaining largely static on Monday as players waited to see if U.S. President Bill Clinton struck a budget deal with the Rebublicans.
The benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 closed 0.14 point down, at 110.12, yielding 6.46 percent. The 10-year yield gap with Germany widened one basis point, to 66 bp.
